description_full: Braiin Limited operates as a technology company. The company applies artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to generate actionable insights across agriculture technology, customer experience and employee experience as a service, and property technology. Its platforms are built on a single technology architecture for data ingestion, insight generation, and automation, which allows capability developed in one vertical to be deployed across the others. It serves enterprise, government, and carrier customers, as well as consumers in the telecommunications connection business. The company operates in Australia, India, Singapore, the United States, the United Kingdom, Malaysia, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, the Netherlands, Sri Lanka, and the Philippines. Braiin Limited was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Subiaco, Australia.
